create_bolt_sdf: create a bolt SDF by calling bolt with a 3D point and plugin attributes
compute_bolt_sdf_grad: compute the SDF gradient of a bolt shape at a given 3D point
test_union_sdf: test the Union SDF operation that returns the minimum of two scalar fields
test_intersection_sdf: test the Intersection SDF operation that returns the maximum of two scalar fields
test_subtraction_sdf: test the Subtraction SDF operation that computes the set difference of two scalar fields
